'''Cidri''' was a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Artisan/Legends|jeweler]] who lived on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], a floating [[Mining/Legends|mining]] colony in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]],<ref name="TJoY" /> at some point between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="Timeframe">The events of ''[[The Jewel of Yavin]]'' took place while [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] was [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], a period which started in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] and ended in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> By this time, Cidri was [[Marriage/Legends|married]] to another Bothan jeweler named [[Henna]], and the pair ran a jewelry business named [[Bothawui Jewellers]] together. The pair's business was run out of a weathered [[JumpMaster 5000/Legends|JumpMaster 5000]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] set up on [[Market Row]], a commercial corridor in Cloud [[City/Legends|City's]] [[Port Town (Cloud City)/Legends|Port Town]] district.<ref name="TJoY" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cidri appeared in ''[[The Jewel of Yavin]]'', an adventure module released in [[2014]] for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' roleplaying game. The jeweler is listed as a merchant players can purchase goods from, but no specific interactions are listed.<ref name="TJoY" />
